Trace, implement and test: 面试题38. 字符串的排列

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    vector<string> permutation(string s) {
        vector<string> ans;
        function<void(int)> dfs = [&](int i) {
            if (i == s.size() - 1) {
                ans.push_back(s);
                return;
            }
            unordered_set<char> vis;
            for (int j = i; j < s.size(); ++j) {
                if (!vis.count(s[j])) {
                    vis.insert(s[j]);
                    swap(s[i], s[j]);
                    dfs(i + 1);
                    swap(s[i], s[j]);
                }
            }
        };
        dfs(0);
        return ans;
    }
};
